signals.name: Fed hikes, banks sell off hard, but VIX doesn't confirm the stress
signals.reading: The Fed's 25bp hike to 3.75%-4.00% on Sep 16/26 and Chair Warsh's hawkish Q&A drove big bank stocks down hard (JPM -1.5%, GS/WFC/BAC/C all down more than 3%, Dow -631pts) while the S&P fell -0.45%; yet VIX held roughly flat at ~17.05 today versus ~17.84 Tuesday morning, and ~17.20 at Tuesday's close — the equity selloff did not translate into a fresh volatility spike
signals.level: VIX ~17.05 (Sep 17/26, -0.87% on the day), down from ~17.84 Tue morning; Dow -631pts, banks -3%+ (Sep 16/26)
signals.angle: A clean, current illustration of a directional equity move landing without a matching vol spike — exactly the kind of dislocation the pool's market-neutral sleeve is designed to exploit, worth walking advisors through explicitly

signals.name: Blackstone's BCRED gates for a second straight quarter on unchanged terms
signals.reading: Blackstone's $77B BCRED will again fulfill only about half of this quarter's roughly 10% redemption requests, holding its 5% cap for a second consecutive quarter — an identical outcome to the prior quarter, with the fund describing itself as 'well capitalized' even as some analysts expect elevated redemption activity into early 2027

signals.angle: Gating has now repeated on the same terms twice in a row — useful to note the pattern is structural and recurring, not a one-off, when making the daily-liquidity case

signals.angle: Continued third-party validation that CCM8752's two lead sleeves sit in exactly the categories institutional allocators say they want most right now

ELITE.asof: Verified online Sep 17, 2026 via web search (iaclarington.com and iaconnected.ia.ca both remained blocked from this session's network again, so items below are cited from live search-result snippets/dates, not full-page fetches). The Tej Rai/Alex Bellefleur segregated-funds handover remains unconfirmed as completed three days after its Sep 14/26 effective date: no newswire.ca, iaclarington.com, Globe and Mail, Wealth Professional or advisor.ca item confirming completion was found today; the only material located is the same standing iaconnected.ia.ca-sourced notice describing the change as forward-looking ('On September 14, 2026, 4 segregated funds... will be taken over...'), not a retrospective confirmation — treat as still pending, not settled. No new September 2026 iA Clarington press release was found beyond the already-known Aug 24/26 Active ETF Series distribution announcement (paid Sep 10/26); the Elite Pools & Unified Portfolios Advisor Lunch & Learn events (Sep 22 Ajax/Markham, Sep 23 London, Sep 24 Kitchener, Sep 25 Oakville) remain scheduled, unchanged. On PIMCO: no update since the Sep 4-5/26 Bloomberg story on Emmanuel Sharef's PIMCO 60/40 Balanced Income and Growth Fund Asia-rotation (~$19B AUM, ~60% of equity allocation now Samsung/SK Hynix/TSMC, underweight 'Magnificent Seven'/hyperscalers) — the same facts are still being recirculated by secondary outlets, nothing dated after Sep 5. On Loomis Sayles: two items newer than the previously-known Aug 4/26 Municipal Sector Outlook were found — an Alpha Engine Perspectives monthly review dated Sep 14/26 (performance, exposures, EM credit and FX regime commentary) and a Sep 1/26 Alpha Engine Perspectives piece on SMID growth companies; full text wasn't retrievable via search snippet, only titles/dates, so treat the existence of new commentary as LIVE but its content as not yet reviewed. On the broader macro backdrop feeding the Elite Pools' sub-advisor positioning: the FOMC voted 12-0 on Sep 16/26 to hike 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% (first since 2023), with Chair Kevin Warsh citing inflation pressure tied to the Iran conflict's oil effects; markets sold off into the press conference (S&P -0.45% to 7,551.81, bank stocks hit hardest) before a Wednesday recovery. The BoJ's own Sep 17-18/26 meeting concludes with a decision expected Sep 18 Tokyo time; near-unanimous consensus expects a hike to a 31-year-high 1.25%, not yet confirmed. Oil eased off its spike as Saudi Aramco said it can restore roughly half the damaged East-West pipeline's capacity within days (Bloomberg, Sep 16/26); the Salalah, Oman meeting remains postponed with no new date. On tariffs: the broader Section 338/Canada trade picture has already escalated well past the narrow Sep 15/26 product-scope tweak previously noted — US 50% Section 338 tariffs on roughly 569 Canadian product categories (~$20B of imports) took effect Aug 22/26, and Canada's retaliatory tariffs (15/25/50% across categories, ~$27.6B of imports) took effect Sep 8/26; the separate, broader US import ban on Canadian dairy, alcohol and motor vehicles (with no USMCA exemption) still takes effect Sep 29/26, replacing the 50% tariff on those specific goods. iA Clarington overall AUM (>$26B, Jul 31/26) and iAGAM firm-wide AUM ($156B, Jun 30/26) were both carried forward unchanged, no fresher figures found today.
ELITE.oneliner: The Fed's first hike since 2023 (Sep 16, 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%) hit bank stocks hard before a Wednesday recovery, the BoJ's own near-certain hike to a 31-year-high 1.25% lands one day later on Sep 18, and the Section 338/Canada tariff war has already escalated well past a narrow scope tweak — US 50% tariffs since Aug 22, Canadian retaliation since Sep 8, with the outright import ban on Canadian dairy, alcohol and motor vehicles still set for Sep 29 — a genuinely live, unresolved macro backdrop for the Elite Pools' PIMCO and Loomis Sayles sleeves, even as the Sep 14 Tej Rai/Bellefleur segregated-funds handover remains unconfirmed as completed three days later.

ELITE.compositionNote: Elite Pools & Unified Portfolios continue to draw on PIMCO, Loomis Sayles and iAGAM as sub-advisors. The structural change at iAGAM was scheduled to take effect Sep 14/26 (Asset Allocation team led by Tej Rai and Alex Bellefleur taking over four segregated funds from external managers; funds renamed, category/risk/objectives unchanged, MER expected to decrease), but three days later no independent source has confirmed completion — treat as 'effective per standing notice, completion still unconfirmed.' On the PIMCO side, the Emmanuel Sharef/PIMCO 60/40 Balanced Income and Growth Fund Asia-rotation story (~$19B AUM, ~60% of equity allocation now Samsung/SK Hynix/TSMC, rotating out of 'Magnificent Seven' US tech) remains the most concrete, current example of sub-advisor positioning, unchanged since Sep 4-5/26 reporting. Loomis Sayles has newly published Alpha Engine Perspectives commentary (Sep 1/26 and Sep 14/26), its first activity since the Aug 4/26 Municipal Sector Outlook — worth pulling the full text before the next advisor conversation. The broader backdrop sharpened again this week: the Fed delivered its first hike since 2023 on Sep 16/26 (25bp to 3.75%-4.00%), hitting bank stocks hard before a Wednesday recovery, while the BoJ's own near-certain hike to a 31-year-high 1.25% lands one day later on Sep 18/26. Oil eased as Saudi Aramco moves to restore partial pipeline capacity within days, though the Salalah, Oman meeting remains postponed. Separately, the Section 338/Canada tariff conflict has already escalated well past a narrow Sep 15 scope tweak — US 50% tariffs since Aug 22/26, Canadian retaliation since Sep 8/26 — with the broader import ban on Canadian dairy/alcohol/motor vehicles still pending Sep 29/26. iA Clarington's overall AUM (>$26B, Jul 31/26) and iAGAM's firm-wide AUM ($156B, Jun 30/26) were both carried forward unchanged. iA Clarington has also scheduled four Elite Pools & Unified Portfolios Advisor Lunch & Learn events across Ontario, Sep 22-25/26.
